title: Key of the Ancients
summary: Circlet gives +1 to Nature checks and opens a Druid Grove shortcut.

fields.Use: Stand in front of the stone door in Nettie’s room in the Emerald Grove to open a shortcut to the Underground Passage.
fields.Variants: Findal carries the Story version in the Underground Passage at X −438, Y −180. Nettie carries the Uncommon version in the Druids’ Chambers at X −440, Y 6. Both have the same Nature bonus and shortcut effect.
fields.Base value: 90 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Nature: +1 to Nature checks while wearing either circlet variant.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
